Verdict written to `page/about/iter-05/verdict.json`. **Overall: 95** (desktop 95, tablet 95, mobile 95) Both iteration-4 actionable issues are closed: - Photo frame now carries the `#ECECEC` hairline - pixel-sampled `rgb(236,236,236)` on all four edges at every breakpoint. - LinkedIn glyph is now 16×16. I pulled the Figma node (no cached reference existed) and overlaid it on the desktop build. The difference mask shows **no structural offset anywhere** - every card border, bullet box, chip and glyph lands on its Figma pixel. Measured: cards `x=48-479` × 146px at `y=332/490/648`, photo `x=618-1391` × `y=332-851`, 48px gutter, section ends 96px below the photo. The `FPO // Image Placeholder` badge is in the Figma node and correctly absent from the build. **The one remaining visible difference is not fixable in this section's file.** The heading falls back from Exposure to Newsreader, which is ~15% narrower at 48px, so Figma's break `One team, built / across industries` becomes `One team, built across / industries`, and the taller ascent lifts the block 5px. The intro region is the only area with a real diff (mean abs 40.3 vs 3.6-7.4 elsewhere) and all of it is glyph shape: line pitch is 48px in both, block origin `x=49` in both, and the mono eyebrow ink box is byte-identical. `about.tsx` already requests `Exposure, Exposure-20, Newsreader, …` correctly - the licensed Exposure and Matter faces are missing from the shared font config. I flagged it as a warning but marked it **non-actionable** so the fixer doesn't hard-code a `
` that would break at other widths. Tablet and mobile have no mock; both adapt exactly per the spec's responsive table with no overflow, clipping or lost content.
